notes.title: Patch 0.4.3
notes.content:
New weapon added: 
Javelin is a versatile weapon that can be used in both melee and ranged combat. After the javelin hits an object or enemy, it can be picked up and used in combat by the player. 

There are two types of javelins: 
1. The default javelin is larger and slower with increased damage, both ranged and melee, but with a lower attack speed. It has a quantity of one, so if the player throws it, it will return to the hand after a time, based on the attack speed. 
2. The quick javelin is a stack of multiple javelins, smaller in size with lower but more compact damage and an increased attack speed. If the javelin is being thrown, after a delay, another one will spawn at the player's hand.

[previewyoutube=IJu-zoaQobw;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Patch 0.4.1
notes.content:
Patch 0.4.1 includes small changes and fixes:

[list]
[*] Add exploration mode (travel to location from map). Cannot progress in story mode from exploration mode.
[*] Map travel is available also for locations that are not discovered in story mode, there are few exceptions.
[*] Regions are now connected to each other by portals.
[*] Player health and damage are increased based on character level.
[*] Allies health and damage are increased based on player level.
[*] Enemies health and damage are increased based on region.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.4
notes.content:
The patch is introducing three main features:
- Encounters: when exploring the half elves kingdom, you will find many adversaries ready to end your journey in forests, around houses or in the middle of the road.
- Bounties: in several regions, heroes with special abilities are ready to give you a great fight.
- Arena: a new region accessible from the main base. There you can train with your fellows or fight the fiercest enemies you encountered so far.

notes.title: Update 0.1
notes.content:
[h1]0.1 Major update containing 3 new additions[/h1]

[h2]1.  Material strength feature:[/h2]
This new feature enables objects or bodies based on their material to be pierced, stop or deflect arrows. As an example lets take a wooden shield, it can be pierced, stop or deflect wooden arrows, but an iron shield has a material stronger than wood, this type of shield would always stop the wooden arrows or deflect them.

If an arrow is piercing an object or body it will continue forward damaging anything in it’s path until it will be stopped. A deflected arrow is also able to do further damage.
Some type of objects cannot deflect arrows, for example flesh or cloth armor.
Demo: 
[previewyoutube=PO1UKd_Ldyo;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h2]2. New shield - Iron Spiked Shield[/h2]
Being made from iron it will always block enemy wooden arrows by stopping or deflecting them.
Demo:
[previewyoutube=HswtdJjYIVQ;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h2]3. Ffirst ranged weapon for player - Wooden Bow[/h2]
It is effective in short range and has a quick reload. Its arrows have a change of piercing wooden shields, cloth armor or flesh. But will always be blocked by shields made from iron or other stronger materials.
Demo:
[previewyoutube=zzzeICG7U6c;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
